overall: The AG resolved the complaint by informal action and found no Open Meeting Law violation, because the director's email went to only two of five board members, so no quorum deliberated.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a June 15, 2011 email exchange between the Authority director and two board members on an Authority matter was deliberation outside an open meeting.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law because the email at issue did not constitute deliberation outside of an open meeting.
